title: agent-crew run session registry
description: Session-level state for one crew:run invocation (including any task-injection extensions). Lives at {STATE_DIR}/session.json. Written by crew:run Step 4 and Step 1.5 injection path. additionalProperties is true so future B-phase / C-phase task fields remain forward-compatible.

schema_version.description: Optional in v1. Pre-F4 session.json files do not have this field; validators tolerate absence.

session_id.description: {YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}. Generated by the original (non-injecting) orchestrator at Step 4.

pre_run_head.description: Git SHA of the pre-run HEAD. Optional — older session.json files may omit it. Used when comparing candidate changes.

session_type.description: Optional session mode. Omitted legacy sessions are plain parallel sessions; variants sessions fan out one task into candidate implementations.

base_task.description: Original task text shared by every candidate in a variants session.

workflow_status.description: v2 실행 단계 또는 resume의 next_action. 후보 완료만으로 전체 status가 completed가 되지 않는다.

variants_dir.description: 새 v2 세션별 리뷰·종합 산출물 경로. STATE_DIR/variants/session_id에 고정된다.

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate variant task entries requested for a variants session.

selection_status.description: Selection gate status for variants sessions.

selected_task_id.description: Selected task id for a variants session after the user chooses a candidate.

apply_history.description: 복구 후 재시도하기 전의 반영 기록.

project_root.description: Task execution root. Variants sessions use isolated worktree roots when the base project is a git repository.

base_project_root.description: Original checkout root when project_root points at an isolated variant worktree.

task_hash.description: Phase B0 — normalized form of task. Pre-B0 entries omit this field; consumers treat missing as 'cannot dedupe'.

injected.description: True when the task was added via the run.md Step 1.5 injection path.

variant_id.description: Stable candidate identifier inside a variants session.

variant_index.description: One-based candidate index inside a variants session.

variant_strategy.description: Human-readable strategy label for this candidate implementation.
